dogecoin.text: @SwedishLincoln @BNYMellonWealth Meh, I still have a little Bitcoin. But the majority of my stash was in Dogecoin, which I made a shitload of money from. I was in Dogecoin since it was a 4chan joke.

@BNYMellonWealth As an early investor in dogecoin and etherium, I am glad I got out before this mess happened, as a concept digital currency is a great idea, but the volatility of it and the high miner's/transaction fees drove me away, I still accept Bitcoin/Ether payments but it's not preferred.

@BroadCastGamer_ @austinnotduncan If you really want to make money, build a time machine back to Jan. 2014, when I put $1000 (from my college savings) in dogecoin.i pulled out (hehe) in may/June last year and I made 12k, you tell me that anyone expected that and I will stop making shitty memes.
